segments.normalizedSource: ```swift override func touchesBegan(_ touches: Set<UITouch>, with event: UIEvent) { if touches.count != 1 { self.state = .failed } // Capture the first touch and store some information about it. if self.trackedTouch == nil { if let firstTouch = touches.first { self.trackedTouch = firstTouch self.addSample(for: firstTouch) state = .began } } else { // Ignore all but the first touch. for touch in touches { if touch != self.trackedTouch { self.ignore(touch, for: event) } } } } func addSample(for touch: UITouch) { let newSample = StrokeSample(location: touch.location(in: self.view)) self.samples.append(newSample) } ```
segments.contextBefore: After the first touch occurs, any new touches added to the event sequence are ignored.
